title: ChatTool

type.description: function; another type is refused with 400, or ignored under ignoreUnsupported.

name.description: 1 to 64 letters, digits, underscores and hyphens; unique among the request's tools.

parameters.description: The call's arguments as a JSON Schema object, handed to the model as written; an object with no properties when absent.

strict.description: Not honoured: reported ignored when true.

function.description: A function the caller declares and runs itself.

description: A tool the caller declares: the model's calls to it come back as tool_calls, and the caller sends each result as a tool message.
